primary_program.note: The proposed eight-gene antigen-presentation program and its unresolved measurement gates are untouched.

recommended_secondary_panel.relationship_to_recovered_set: Exact recovered membership; published signed coefficients and normalization must replace the unoriented GMT interpretation.
recommended_secondary_panel.question: Does the frozen B methylation program improve prediction of a bulk T-cell-inflamed/adaptive-resistance expression state beyond its matched clinical baseline?

recommended_secondary_panel.relationship_to_recovered_set: Use an exact versioned official 200-gene membership; do not use or call the recovered 10-gene mini the Hallmark set. The current official membership overlaps primary P at 6/8 genes, so prespecify an intact-reference primary score and a P-gene-excluded sensitivity score.
recommended_secondary_panel.question: Does the frozen B methylation program improve prediction of a broad IFNG-induced transcriptional response beyond its matched clinical baseline?

multiplicity.family: the two secondary Delta_R2 tests only
multiplicity.method: Holm family-wise error control at two-sided alpha=0.05

nonnegotiable_freeze_gates: Exact source bytes, version, license/redistribution status, identifier namespace, and SHA-256 for each membership.
Ayers coefficient vector, sign, housekeeping normalization, platform transport rule, and missing-gene rule.
Official Hallmark release and exact 200-gene membership plus ssGSEA/GSVA package version and all parameters.
Canonical raw-to-current identifier mapping with aliases retained and duplicate loci collapsed before scoring.
Full-member CPC finite-value coverage and historical two-platform mapping coverage; no outcome values inspected.
Minimum retained set size and deterministic missing-feature behavior fixed before any CPC outcome analysis.
One matched baseline and one matched extended model per secondary endpoint, with all fitting and tuning confined to TCGA.
CPC outcomes prohibited from membership, scoring, promoter, covariate, or model selection.
